name: Takeover: fingerprint sweep -> claim -> cookie-scope abuse
goal: Sweep abandoned service fingerprints across providers, claim the dangling origin, and abuse parent-scope cookies.
preconditions: Subdomain DNS CNAME pointing at a removed service.
impact: Attacker-controlled content on trusted origin; cookie injection into parent scope; OAuth allow-list capture.

steps.purpose: GitHub Pages dangle detection (404 + 'There isn't a GitHub Pages site here.').
steps.on_success: Claim via GH Pages repo -> trusted origin controlled.
Claim the bucket name -> origin controlled.

steps.purpose: Fastly dangle fingerprint ('Fastly error: unknown domain').
steps.on_fail: No fingerprint hit -> enumerate more providers via can-i-take-over-xyz list (documented extension path).

steps.purpose: Convert origin control into session attack: overbroad Domain cookies are injectable from your subdomain.
steps.on_success: Cookie fixation/injection into the parent app.
steps.on_fail: Cookie scope tight -> content phishing + OAuth allow-list pivot (oauth-session-ato).

recon.name: CNAME census
recon.how: Resolve every subdomain; collect CNAME targets; flag NXDOMAIN/CNAME pairs and provider fingerprints.

recon.name: Fingerprint library sweep
recon.how: Run the full can-i-take-over-xyz fingerprint list (Heroku, Azure, CloudFront, Tumblr, Zendesk, Tilda, Readme.io, Surge.sh, Pantheon, Unbounce, Short.io, ...).

recon.name: Wayback orphan hunt
recon.how: Subdomains that existed historically but resolve nowhere now = prime candidates.

recon.name: Wildcard exclusion
recon.how: Verify wildcard DNS records — wildcards mask takeovers; find and handle them.
recon.signal: Everything resolves -> check wildcard suffix behavior.

pivot_hints: phishing from trusted subdomain = separate severity narrative
